original_profile_text.short: The UNBC TimberWhales are an active underwater-hockey club in Prince George, British Columbia, recognized by NUGSS. For fall 2026, the club announces Sunday 5:45–6:45 pm and Wednesday 9–10 pm practices at Canfor Leisure Pool, with new and returning players welcome.
original_profile_text.wiki: Revived in fall 2023, the UNBC TimberWhales build on a UNBC underwater-hockey team documented by 2009. The club combines pool training, an annual three-on-three tournament, national competition and team socials. Its website records participation in the 2024 Canadian Nationals, and its May 2026 report celebrates a second Nationals appearance for the revived team. Fall 2026 practices take place at Canfor Leisure Pool, 670 Quebec Street, on Sundays from 5:45 to 6:45 pm and Wednesdays from 9 to 10 pm. Contact timberwhales@unbc.ca or the club’s Instagram for first-visit details. The website advertises two free trial practices, but fees, equipment availability and joining requirements should be confirmed. Its public roster is undated and should not be treated as a current-season lineup.
original_profile_text.freshness_banner: Fall 2026 hours verified from the club’s September 12 announcement; checked October 2, 2026. The CUGA directory still shows an older venue and schedule.
original_profile_text.who_plays_text: The public website lists 20 players and staff, but provides no roster date. An April 2025 post named Keegan and Phoenix as incoming co-presidents; a March 2026 AGM announcement means current officers need confirmation. Taryn Atkinson and Shayden Hiebert were publicly interviewed as players in May 2026.
